name: Wang Hailin
bio: Wang Hailin (汪海林) is a Chinese screenwriter.

credits.title: Good Night Beijing
credits.overview: Beijing is the place where dreams come true or at least that’s what a group of young and ambitious people from different parts are hoping for. Romance could be in their future but also heartbreak as well, leading them to question just where they stand in such a city. Will they find the career and partner of their dream

credits.title: Murder at Honeymoon Hotel
credits.overview: Wu Dazhi is a doorman at a luxury hotel. He uses his vacation in exchange of a presidential suite at the hotel to satisfy his wife's wish. However, the manager gives the presidential suite to a celebrity and breaks the deal with him. He tries to ask bargain with the movie star, but strange things happen during his deal

credits.title: The Assassins
credits.overview: In his old age, Cao Cao assesses his former military tactics, love, and relationship with his son.
